summary: Official MINVU IDE/MINVU ArcGIS metadata and an anonymous exact-point query were successful, but the returned PRC_Iquique polygon is planning/zoning geometry rather than cadastral parcel geometry. No local registry/cadastre parcel service was confirmed, so no parcel GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish discovery queries are recorded in city-195-iquique.json. They found official MINVU planning data, IDE Chile catalog documentation, SII references, and CIREN rural-property product information, but no confirmed public parcel API for Iquique.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Layer metadata retrieved; PRC_Iquique is an esriGeometryPolygon planning-regulation layer in EPSG:32719 with OBJECTID.
Exact WUP point queried with inSR=4326, outFields=OBJECTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326; one PRC polygon OBJECTID 844 returned. This is not evidence of a parcel hit.
Cloudflare challenge/login-wall-like response; no bypass, browser challenge, credentials, or private token used.

Official SII documentation indicates detailed SII-Mapas interoperability access is restricted to authorized institutional users and that displayed parcel maps are referential; no restricted access was attempted.
Official IDE catalog documents MINVU responsibility for the Límites Prediales Urbanos feature category, but does not expose a confirmed Iquique public query endpoint in this attempt.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude; ArcGIS query geometry was supplied as longitude/latitude per ArcGIS REST convention. No coordinate shift applied.

nativeFieldMapping.OBJECTID: stable native ArcGIS layer object identifier for the queried planning feature
nativeFieldMapping.geometry: native polygon geometry returned as GeoJSON EPSG:4326

geometryQuality: One unchanged planning polygon was returned by the official public service, but it was not retained because it is not a cadastral parcel.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact point query returned one non-parcel planning feature; zero parcel samples retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: MINVU PRC Iquique planning-regulation layer, not cadastral coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous metadata and exact-point ID-plus-geometry access to the official planning service.

scopeLimits: The planning layer cannot be used as a cadastral parcel source or proof of legal property boundaries.
No local Iquique registry/cadastre/map procedure with safe anonymous parcel geometry was confirmed.
SII-Mapas institutional interoperability and richer property attributes were not accessed because they require authorized users and may expose unsafe fields.
The municipality site was Cloudflare-challenged; this is not evidence of source absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
A zero parcel result, challenge, extent miss or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: A public cadastral parcel endpoint may exist behind a different official viewer or controlled institutional service. Parcel completeness, legal status, update currency, and stable parcel identity remain unverified.
